verdict.rationale: Proton documents an official Proton Pass CLI. It supports create, read, update and delete operations on vaults and on many item types, and it can retrieve secrets in scripts, deployments and CI/CD pipelines, which is the core of an AI-native or automation workflow. All of this evidence comes from a single first-party blog post. Missing for 10: in-depth CLI reference docs (commands, auth, machine-readable output), agent-specific guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as described.
